result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom tab bar is visually broken: the system home-indicator bar is drawn directly across the navigation icons and the icons themselves are clipped by the screen edge, indicating missing safe-area padding. A few smaller inconsistencies exist (unlabeled tab icons, inconsistent favorite-button treatment, low-contrast search placeholder).

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the horizontal home-indicator bar overlaps the Search and Orders icons, and the icons appear vertically clipped at the bottom screen edge. The tab bar has no bottom safe-area inset, so its content collides with the system gesture indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (e.g. env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the tab bar and increase its height so icons sit fully above the home indicator with consistent vertical centering.

issues.description: Bottom navigation items are icon-only with no text labels, and the active state is conveyed by color alone (green Home icon), making the destinations ambiguous and the state hard to perceive for color-blind users.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon and reinforce the active state with a non-color cue (filled icon variant, indicator pill, or bold label).

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently across the 'Popular right now' cards: the ramen card shows a bare white heart outline while the pizza card shows the heart inside a translucent dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular scrim/background treatment to all favorite buttons so they remain legible and consistent over any image.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving low contrast that may fail WCAG text contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (or lighten the field fill) to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the input background.
